nodes.name: Every 15 Minutes
nodes.notes: Polls the approved watch folder. No inbound port, no cloud.

nodes.name: Read Watch Folder
nodes.notes: Bind mount data/raw READ-ONLY. Restricted by N8N_RESTRICT_FILE_ACCESS_TO.

nodes.name: Loop Over Files
nodes.notes: One file at a time: Phase 3A ingestion is synchronous and CPU-bound.

nodes.name: HTTP: Process P&ID
nodes.notes: Local PaddleOCR is slow on CPU. Long timeout, low retry count.

nodes.name: HTTP: Ingest Document
nodes.notes: Phase 3A synchronous ingest: Docling + BGE + Qdrant on CPU can take minutes.
